brief.title: Housekeeping Task Management System
business_goals: Modernize housekeeping task assignment and room status tracking to a mobile system.
Automate 'dirty' room status on guest checkout and assign tasks based on housekeeper workload.
Automate supervisor notification for 'ready for inspection' rooms and require approval before rooms are available for sale.
Enable supervisors to prioritize rooms for urgent cleaning.
Automatically display VIP-specific cleaning checklists for VIP rooms.
Improve room readiness for guest check-in times and accountability for room assignments.
Retain one year of room status and inspection history for quality audits.

stakeholders.name: Carlos Ibarra
concerns: Housekeeping assignments are still handed out on a printed sheet each morning.
Need room status and task assignment to move onto a mobile system.
Supervisors should be able to flag a room as priority to jump to the top of a housekeeper's queue.
Launch before the year-end peak season in December.
Budget of SGD 150,000 for initial rollout across three properties.

stakeholders.name: Mei Ling Tan
concerns: When a guest checks out, the room needs to automatically appear as 'dirty' and get assigned to a housekeeper based on their current workload.
Rooms marked 'ready for inspection' should notify a supervisor automatically, and the supervisor needs to approve it before the room shows as available for the front desk to sell again.
For VIP guests, housekeepers should see a VIP-specific checklist automatically when the room is tagged VIP in Opera.
Guests complaining that rooms weren't ready even after 3pm check-in, and difficulty figuring out which housekeeper was assigned.

stakeholders.name: Aaliyah Rahman
concerns: Housekeepers need a simple app on a handheld device to mark a room as in-progress, then clean, then ready for inspection.
The app has to work without needing a strong signal (terrible WiFi in stairwells and back corridors).
Housekeepers should be able to log lost and found items with a photo right from the same app, tagged to the room number and date.

stakeholders.name: Josef Novak
concerns: Our property management system is Opera Cloud.
Room status changes have to sync with Opera in both directions (e.g., front desk marking a room out of order).
Room status changes need to reflect across all devices within 15 seconds.
Need at least one year of room status and inspection history retained for quality audits.

constraints: Existing property management system is Opera Cloud; room status changes must sync bi-directionally.
Room status changes must reflect across all devices within 15 seconds.
System must function without needing a strong WiFi signal in all areas.
Launch target is before the year-end peak season in December.
Budget of SGD 150,000 for initial rollout across three properties.
At least one year of room status and inspection history must be retained.
out_of_scope: Minibar restocking and billing is out of scope for this project — that's handled by a separate F&B system already, we don't want to touch that.
open_questions: What specific handheld devices will housekeepers use, and what operating system do they run?
How is 'current workload' defined for automatic task assignment (e.g., number of rooms, estimated time, specific room types)?
What is the desired workflow for lost and found items after they are logged with a photo?
What specific data points from room status and inspection history are needed for quality audits?

requirements.statement: The system shall provide a mobile application for housekeepers to manage room status and task assignments.
requirements.evidence: We need room status and task assignment to move onto a mobile system the housekeepers can use directly.

requirements.statement: The system shall automatically mark a room as 'dirty' upon guest checkout and assign it to a housekeeper based on their current workload.
requirements.evidence: When a guest checks out, the room needs to automatically appear as "dirty" and get assigned to a housekeeper based on their current workload, not just whoever's next on a list.

requirements.statement: The system shall enable housekeepers to update a room's status to 'in-progress', 'clean', and 'ready for inspection' via the mobile application.
requirements.evidence: Housekeepers need a simple app on a handheld device to mark a room as in-progress, then clean, then ready for inspection.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow housekeepers to perform their tasks and update room statuses in the mobile application without requiring a strong network signal.
requirements.evidence: It has to work without needing a strong signal — a lot of our stairwells and back corridors have terrible WiFi.

requirements.statement: The system shall automatically notify a supervisor when a room is marked 'ready for inspection' and require supervisor approval before the room's status is updated to 'available for sale'.
requirements.evidence: Rooms marked "ready for inspection" should notify a supervisor automatically, and the supervisor needs to approve it before the room shows as available for the front desk to sell again.

requirements.statement: The system shall bi-directionally synchronize room status changes with Opera Cloud.
requirements.evidence: Room status changes have to sync with Opera in both directions — if front desk marks a room out of order in Opera, housekeeping should see that immediately, and vice versa.

requirements.statement: The system shall enable supervisors to flag a room as 'priority' to move it to the top of a housekeeper's task queue.
requirements.evidence: Ideally supervisors can flag a room as priority and it jumps to the top of a housekeeper's queue.

requirements.statement: The system shall automatically display a VIP-specific cleaning checklist to housekeepers when a room is tagged as VIP in Opera.
requirements.evidence: For VIP guests, there's a checklist that's different from standard rooms — turndown service, specific amenity placement — housekeepers should see that VIP checklist automatically when the room is tagged VIP in Opera.

requirements.statement: The system shall enable housekeepers to log lost and found items, including a photo, room number, and date, directly from the mobile application.
requirements.evidence: when a housekeeper finds an item, they should be able to log it with a photo right from the same app, tagged to the room number and date.

requirements.statement: The system shall reflect room status changes across all devices within 15 seconds.
requirements.rationale: if two housekeepers are near the same room, we don't want them both walking in.
requirements.evidence: room status changes need to reflect across all devices within 15 seconds

requirements.statement: The system shall not manage minibar restocking or billing.
requirements.evidence: Minibar restocking and billing is out of scope for this project — that's handled by a separate F&B system already, we don't want to touch that.

requirements.statement: The system shall retain at least one year of room status and inspection history.
requirements.rationale: mainly so Rooms can pull data for quality audits.
requirements.evidence: We need at least one year of room status and inspection history retained, mainly so Rooms can pull data for quality audits.

epics.title: Housekeeper Mobile Workflow
epics.goal: Enable housekeepers to efficiently manage their assigned tasks and update room statuses using a mobile application, even offline.

epics.title: Automated Task Management & Supervisor Oversight
epics.goal: Automate the assignment of cleaning tasks and provide supervisors with tools to manage room readiness and prioritize cleaning efforts.

epics.title: PMS Integration & Audit History
epics.goal: Ensure seamless integration with the Property Management System and maintain a comprehensive history of room statuses for auditing purposes.

stories.title: Access assigned tasks on a mobile application
stories.i_want: to access my assigned tasks on a mobile application
stories.so_that: I can see my daily workload and plan my work effectively

acceptance_criteria.given: I am a logged-in housekeeper
acceptance_criteria.when: I open the mobile application
acceptance_criteria.then: I see a list of rooms assigned to me

acceptance_criteria.given: I am a logged-in housekeeper
acceptance_criteria.when: there are no rooms assigned to me
acceptance_criteria.then: I see a message indicating no tasks

stories.title: Update a room's status to 'in-progress'
stories.i_want: to update a room's status to 'in-progress'
stories.so_that: supervisors know I have started cleaning the room

acceptance_criteria.given: I have an assigned room in my task list
acceptance_criteria.when: I select the room and tap 'Start Cleaning'
acceptance_criteria.then: the room status changes to 'in-progress'

acceptance_criteria.given: a room is already 'in-progress'
acceptance_criteria.when: I tap 'Start Cleaning' again for the same room
acceptance_criteria.then: the room status remains 'in-progress'

stories.title: Update a room's status to 'clean'
stories.i_want: to update a room's status to 'clean'
stories.so_that: I can indicate the primary cleaning is complete

acceptance_criteria.given: a room's status is 'in-progress'
acceptance_criteria.when: I tap 'Mark Clean' on the mobile application
acceptance_criteria.then: the room status changes to 'clean'

acceptance_criteria.given: a room's status is not 'in-progress'
acceptance_criteria.when: I tap 'Mark Clean' on the mobile application

stories.title: Update a room's status to 'ready for inspection'
stories.i_want: to update a room's status to 'ready for inspection'
stories.so_that: a supervisor can review my work and approve the room for sale

acceptance_criteria.given: a room's status is 'clean'
acceptance_criteria.when: I tap 'Ready for Inspection' on the mobile application
acceptance_criteria.then: the room status changes to 'ready for inspection'

acceptance_criteria.given: a room's status is not 'clean'
acceptance_criteria.when: I tap 'Ready for Inspection' on the mobile application
acceptance_criteria.then: the system prevents the status change and displays an error message

stories.title: Update room statuses offline
stories.i_want: to update room statuses in the mobile application without a strong network signal
stories.so_that: I can continue working and updating room statuses without interruptions

acceptance_criteria.given: I am offline and have an assigned room
acceptance_criteria.when: I update a room status (e.g., to 'in-progress')
acceptance_criteria.then: the status change is stored locally on my device

acceptance_criteria.given: I am offline and have updated a room status
acceptance_criteria.when: I regain network connectivity
acceptance_criteria.then: the locally stored status change is automatically synchronized with the system

acceptance_criteria.given: I am offline and update a room status
acceptance_criteria.when: I attempt to view a task list that requires live data
acceptance_criteria.then: the application displays the most recent locally available data and indicates offline mode

stories.title: Display a VIP-specific cleaning checklist for VIP rooms
stories.i_want: to see a VIP-specific cleaning checklist for VIP rooms
stories.so_that: I ensure all special requirements for VIP guests are met

acceptance_criteria.given: a room is tagged as VIP in Opera Cloud
acceptance_criteria.when: I select the VIP room in my mobile application
acceptance_criteria.then: a VIP-specific cleaning checklist is displayed for that room

acceptance_criteria.given: a room is not tagged as VIP
acceptance_criteria.when: I select the room in my mobile application
acceptance_criteria.then: the standard cleaning checklist is displayed

stories.title: Record a lost and found item with details and a photo
stories.i_want: to record a lost and found item with its room, date, and a photo
stories.so_that: the item can be properly documented and returned to its owner

acceptance_criteria.given: I am in a room and find an item
acceptance_criteria.when: I select 'Log Lost & Found', take a photo, enter the room number and date, and submit
acceptance_criteria.then: the lost and found item is recorded in the system with the photo, room number, and date

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logging a lost and found item
acceptance_criteria.when: I attempt to submit without taking a photo
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays an error message 'Photo is required' and prevents submission

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logging a lost and found item
acceptance_criteria.when: I submit the item without entering the room number
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays an error message 'Room number is required' and prevents submission

stories.title: Automatically mark a room as 'dirty' upon guest checkout
stories.i_want: to automatically mark a room as 'dirty' upon guest checkout
stories.so_that: it is ready for cleaning assignment without manual intervention

acceptance_criteria.given: a guest checks out of a room in Opera Cloud
acceptance_criteria.when: Opera Cloud sends a checkout notification to the system
acceptance_criteria.then: the room status in the system is updated to 'dirty'

acceptance_criteria.given: a room is already marked 'dirty'
acceptance_criteria.when: a checkout notification for that room is received again
acceptance_criteria.then: the room status remains 'dirty' and no new task is generated

stories.title: Automatically assign dirty rooms to housekeepers based on workload
stories.i_want: dirty rooms to be automatically assigned to housekeepers based on their current workload
stories.so_that: cleaning tasks are distributed efficiently and fairly without manual intervention

acceptance_criteria.given: Room 201 is marked 'dirty' and Housekeeper A has 2 rooms, Housekeeper B has 1 room
acceptance_criteria.when: the system processes the dirty room for assignment
acceptance_criteria.then: Room 201 is assigned to Housekeeper B, and displayed in Housekeeper B's mobile task list

acceptance_criteria.given: Room 202 is marked 'dirty' and all available housekeepers have reached their maximum assigned room limit
acceptance_criteria.when: the system attempts to assign Room 202
acceptance_criteria.then: Room 202 is added to an 'unassigned rooms' queue for manual review by a supervisor

stories.title: Automatically mark room as dirty upon guest checkout
stories.i_want: rooms to be automatically marked as 'dirty' upon guest checkout
stories.so_that: housekeepers can be assigned to clean them promptly

acceptance_criteria.given: a guest checks out of Room 101
acceptance_criteria.when: the system processes the guest checkout
acceptance_criteria.then: Room 101's status is updated to 'dirty' in the system

acceptance_criteria.given: a guest checks out of Room 102, but the room was already marked 'out of service'
acceptance_criteria.when: the system processes the guest checkout
acceptance_criteria.then: Room 102's status remains 'out of service' and is not changed to 'dirty'

stories.title: Approve a room after inspection
stories.i_want: to approve a room after inspection
stories.so_that: it can be marked 'available for sale' and made ready for the next guest

acceptance_criteria.given: a room's status is 'ready for inspection'
acceptance_criteria.when: I approve the room via the supervisor interface
acceptance_criteria.then: the room status changes to 'available for sale'

acceptance_criteria.given: a room's status is 'ready for inspection'
acceptance_criteria.when: I reject the room via the supervisor interface, providing a reason
acceptance_criteria.then: the room status reverts to 'dirty' and is reassigned for cleaning

acceptance_criteria.given: a room's status is 'ready for inspection'
acceptance_criteria.when: I attempt to approve a room that is not assigned to me
acceptance_criteria.then: the system prevents the approval and displays an error message

stories.title: Flag a room as 'priority'
stories.so_that: it moves to the top of a housekeeper's task queue for urgent cleaning

acceptance_criteria.given: a room is assigned to a housekeeper
acceptance_criteria.when: I flag the room as 'priority' in the system
acceptance_criteria.then: the room moves to the top of that housekeeper's task list

acceptance_criteria.given: a room is unassigned and marked 'dirty'
acceptance_criteria.when: I flag the room as 'priority'
acceptance_criteria.then: the room is immediately assigned to the next available housekeeper as their top priority task

acceptance_criteria.given: a room is already marked 'priority'
acceptance_criteria.when: I attempt to flag it as 'priority' again
acceptance_criteria.then: the room's priority status remains unchanged

stories.title: Synchronize room status changes to Opera Cloud
stories.i_want: to synchronize room status changes to Opera Cloud
stories.so_that: Opera Cloud has the most current room availability for guest check-ins

acceptance_criteria.given: a room status changes in the system (e.g., to 'available for sale')
acceptance_criteria.when: the status is updated
acceptance_criteria.then: the new status is sent to Opera Cloud via API

acceptance_criteria.given: a room status change fails to synchronize with Opera Cloud
acceptance_criteria.when: the synchronization attempt fails
acceptance_criteria.then: the system retries the synchronization for up to 3 attempts before logging an error

stories.title: Receive room status changes from Opera Cloud
stories.i_want: to receive room status changes from Opera Cloud
stories.so_that: the system accurately reflects guest check-ins and check-outs

acceptance_criteria.given: a room status changes in Opera Cloud (e.g., guest checks out)
acceptance_criteria.when: Opera Cloud sends a status update to the system
acceptance_criteria.then: the system updates its internal room status accordingly

acceptance_criteria.given: Opera Cloud sends an invalid or unrecognized room status
acceptance_criteria.when: the system receives the update
acceptance_criteria.then: the system logs the error and does not update the room status, retaining the previous valid status

stories.title: Rapid update of 'ready for inspection' status on supervisor dashboard
stories.i_want: to see rooms marked 'ready for inspection' appear on my dashboard within 15 seconds
stories.so_that: I can promptly approve them and make them available for sale

acceptance_criteria.given: a housekeeper marks a room 'ready for inspection' on their mobile app while online
acceptance_criteria.when: I am viewing the supervisor dashboard
acceptance_criteria.then: the room's status updates to 'ready for inspection' within 15 seconds

acceptance_criteria.given: a housekeeper marks a room 'ready for inspection' on their mobile app while offline
acceptance_criteria.when: the housekeeper's device regains connectivity and successfully synchronizes the change
acceptance_criteria.then: the room's status updates to 'ready for inspection' on the supervisor dashboard within 15 seconds of successful synchronization

acceptance_criteria.given: a room is marked 'ready for inspection' and I am not currently viewing the dashboard
acceptance_criteria.when: I open or refresh the supervisor dashboard
acceptance_criteria.then: the room's status is immediately displayed as 'ready for inspection'

stories.notes: Revised to narrow scope to a specific critical status update ('ready for inspection') for the supervisor dashboard, addressing the 'too large' feedback while retaining the 15-second SLA and offline sync for this specific flow. This makes it more estimable and small enough for a sprint, focusing on a high-value user outcome.

stories.title: Retain at least one year of room status and inspection history
stories.i_want: to access room status and inspection history for at least one year
stories.so_that: I can perform quality checks and comply with regulatory requirements

acceptance_criteria.given: a room status or inspection record is created
acceptance_criteria.when: 365 days pass since its creation
acceptance_criteria.then: the record is still accessible and viewable in the system

acceptance_criteria.given: a room status or inspection record is created
acceptance_criteria.when: 366 days pass since its creation
acceptance_criteria.then: the record is still accessible and viewable in the system

acceptance_criteria.given: a room status or inspection record is created
acceptance_criteria.when: the system attempts to purge data older than one year
acceptance_criteria.then: records less than 365 days old are not deleted

gaps.description: The business goal of 'accountability for room assignments' is not explicitly addressed by any requirement or story beyond basic assignment and data retention. There's no clear mechanism for reviewing or reporting on who was assigned which room and when for accountability purposes.
gaps.suggested_question: How will the system specifically support accountability for room assignments? Do we need specific reports or views to show who cleaned which room and when, or to track performance related to assignments?

gaps.description: There are no explicit security requirements for the mobile application or the system's integration with Opera Cloud, such as user authentication, authorization, or data protection, which are critical for a system handling operational data and accessible via mobile devices.
gaps.suggested_question: What are the security requirements for the mobile application and the system's integration with Opera Cloud, especially regarding user authentication, authorization, and data privacy?

gaps.description: No specific availability or uptime targets have been stated for the system, despite housekeeping being a critical, continuous operation in a hotel.
gaps.suggested_question: What are the expected uptime and availability targets for the housekeeping task management system, given its critical role in hotel operations?

gaps.description: Requirement R-004 (offline functionality) and R-010 (15-second synchronization) appear to be in conflict. If a housekeeper updates a room status while offline, that update cannot propagate to other devices within 15 seconds until the device reconnects.
gaps.suggested_question: How should the system handle the 15-second synchronization requirement (R-010) when a housekeeper is using the mobile application offline (R-004)? Does the 15-second target apply only once the device regains connectivity, or is there an expectation for near-real-time updates even from offline actions?

gaps.description: The definition of 'current workload' for automatic task assignment (R-002) is not specified, making it unclear how assignments will be prioritized or distributed. This was also an open question in the brief.
gaps.suggested_question: How is 'current workload' defined for automatic task assignment (R-002)? For example, is it based on the number of rooms, estimated cleaning time, or specific room types?

gaps.description: Requirement R-009 covers logging lost and found items, but the subsequent workflow for these items (e.g., who reviews them, how they are stored, how guests are notified) is not defined. This was also an open question in the brief.
gaps.suggested_question: What is the desired workflow for lost and found items (R-009) after they are logged with a photo? Who needs to see them, and what actions should be taken?

gaps.description: The Front Desk team is a critical consumer of the system's output (room availability for sale) and directly impacted by its performance, but no specific representative from this group is listed as a stakeholder.
gaps.suggested_question: Should we include a Front Desk Manager or representative as a stakeholder, given their reliance on accurate room availability for guest check-ins and sales?

gaps.coverage_note: The backlog provides good coverage for the core functional requirements and several non-functional aspects like offline capability and rapid synchronization. Key business goals such as automating dirty room status, supervisor approvals, and VIP checklists are addressed. However, there are some areas that require further clarification, particularly regarding the definition of 'current workload' for task assignment, the full workflow for lost and found items, and how offline updates interact with the real-time synchronization requirement. Additionally, explicit security and availability targets are missing, and the system's support for 'accountability' in room assignments needs more definition. Involving a Front Desk stakeholder would also be beneficial.
